datum.variablename: Eudicotyledoneae (triporate, annular exine, psilate, cf. Celtis)

chronology.notes: There is a slump of sand layer between 31.5-6 cm

site.sitedescription: Core site characterised by small depressions occupied by peat bogs.The site is situated inside the Podocarpus National Park. The analysed core is situated close to the exposed crest near the Cerro Toledo pass, which is today a paved road.
